description: The creator artfletch publishes a photogrammetric mesh of the viaduct arch where Millstream Road passes beneath the London Bridge–Greenwich railway in Southwark, London. The January 2022 source model was reconstructed in RealityCapture from 1,493 photographs taken with a Sony a7R III. Zenodo exposes a GLB mesh and preview images as an Objaverse/Sketchfab mirror, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The geometry can supply a visual environment asset for infrastructure or sensor-scene simulations. It is not documented as a structural finite-element model: metric scale, georeferencing, hidden surfaces, material properties and reconstruction uncertainty remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this identified arch. Use for engineering geometry requires further checks. The mesh and images were not downloaded, and no structural or measurement accuracy was inferred from visual appearance.
